2026-11-03.title: Peloton Tread Walk + Run / Walk
2026-11-03.detail: Week 1: 30 sec easy jog + 2 min walk × 8. Start with 5 min easy walking, then 8 easy intervals and a 5-min walking cooldown. Conversational effort; brisk walk in place of jogging if uncomfortable.

2026-11-04.title: Peloton Beginner Strength
2026-11-04.detail: Beginner full-body / lower-body strength: low step-ups or supported squats, hinge/glutes, calf raises and core as comfortable.

2026-11-05.title: Peloton Tread Walk + Run / Walk
2026-11-05.detail: Week 1: 30 sec easy jog + 2 min walk × 8. Include 5 min easy walking warm-up and cooldown; don't match a Peloton instructor's faster intervals or hills. Walking instead of jogging is valid.

2026-11-06.title: Optional Peloton Bike Low Impact
2026-11-06.detail: Easy ride at RPE 2–4/10. Full rest or dog walk is entirely fine.

2026-11-07.title: Recovery: easy dog walk or full rest
2026-11-07.detail: No required extra session. Your existing easy dog walk or full rest both count as following the plan.

2026-11-07.detail: Only if you feel like moving; no obligation.
